hard_rules: frontends depend on wow-service only and never call lower owners directly
operation exposure comes only from a closed reviewed immutable registry
no generic call-service MCP tool RPC shell script plugin or model escape hatch
wire request identity and durable operation identity remain separate
protocol profiles pin LSP 3.18 MCP 2025-11-25 and wow-local-jsonrpc/1
negotiation can narrow but never widen registry effect authorization privacy or authority
unimplemented operations are not advertised
workspaces are explicitly registered and never inferred from cwd Git editor or WoW installation
folder changes configuration changes and file-watch notifications each map atomically to one service operation
file-watch notifications are hints and never exact source or reindex success evidence
unsaved documents are exact versioned project-owned overlays
position encoding and document versions are exact and stale changes require resynchronization
local daemon is current-user local IPC and no remote listener is enabled by default
LSP methods project existing service results and do not create editor-specific semantics
MCP default tools are fixed non-source-mutating analysis operations and every descriptor preserves its actual effect class and annotations
MCP prompts sampling elicitation tasks arbitrary roots and user-source provider calibration publication activation release or external effects are absent initially
MCP local HTTP is loopback only Origin validated authenticated and disabled by default
tool annotations and model invocation are never authorization
disconnect is not cancellation and progress is not completion
OutcomeUnknown blocks blind retry and final responses are retrieved rather than recomputed
backpressure is bounded and final results outrank progress and logs
multi-client workspaces overlays authorization source operations and results are isolated
no public success before retention audit and reverse resource closure
missing implementation client platform protocol adapter benchmark or checksum evidence is blocked or NotEvaluated never pass
no Cargo Rust source release workflow or public package during documentation phase
